# Central Ohio Land Clearing
## https://centralohiolandclearing.com

Central Ohio Land Clearing provides land clearing, lot clearing, fence-line clearing, and forestry mulching services across a four-county footprint in central Ohio, including Licking County.

## Services

- Land Clearing — full lot and acreage clearing for building sites
- Forestry Mulching — low-impact mulching for brush and small trees
- Fence-Line Clearing — clearing overgrowth along property and fence lines
- Lot Clearing — residential and commercial building lot prep
- Brush Removal and Underbrush Clearing
- Tree and Stump Removal — site-clearing related tree and stump removal
- Right-of-Way Clearing

## Service Area

Four-county footprint in central Ohio, including:
- Licking County, OH
- Newark, OH
- Franklin County, OH
- Knox County, OH
- Fairfield County, OH
